source.citation: Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry Jena roof weather observations.
source.license_note: Local research copy; verify upstream redistribution terms before packaging raw files.
source.parser: latin1 csv.DictReader; date format %d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S; top-of-hour rows only; required block reindexed hourly with missing hours left as NaN
source_notes: Four-channel order follows Study31 Jena parser.
First two columns are scored targets; next two are context-only covariates masked from target loss/scoring.
2021/2022 periods are new target-label windows under checked local study histories, but source/pretraining exposure is not ruled out.

loader_metadata.downsample_rule: keep only top-of-hour rows; no six-row averaging
loader_metadata.duplicate_rule: exact duplicate top-of-hour rows are collapsed; conflicting duplicate cells become NaN

source.parser: pyarrow Parquet reader; raw 30min Time grid aggregated to hourly mean; required block reindexed hourly with missing hours left as NaN
source_notes: First two fixed E_ generator columns are scored targets; next two are context-only covariates.

loader_metadata.hourly_aggregation_rule: mean of same-hour 30min rows using available finite values; hour is NaN for a channel only when all contributing raw values are missing
loader_metadata.selection_rule: fixed from pre-run availability audit: active E_ generator columns, all proposed split parts finite>=0.70 and nonconstant; first four by BMU ID among passing columns; no forecast performance used

data_contract.fit_archives: train+validation only; physically truncated at validation end with no cal/eval origin arrays
data_contract.holdout_archives: full 242-day block with calibration/evaluation origins; read only after selection gates allow forecast stage
data_contract.context_target_alignment: origin is first target timestamp; context [origin-336h, origin), target [origin, origin+48h)
data_contract.between_split_target_overlap: none across train/V and V/cal due 48h embargo; cal last target end equals eval first origin under half-open windows
data_contract.missing_policy: target_values preserve raw hourly NaNs; context_values use precontext-only median fallback then causal forward fill; no future backfill and no target imputation
data_contract.fit_statistics: mean/std/median fitted from observed train interval rows only
data_contract.forecast_subsample_note: archives keep all 80 E origins; run.py may predeclaredly forecast eval_origins[::4] for the bounded initial screen

exposure_summary.claim_limit: new target-label periods under checked local study history; not new raw sources; FM pretraining overlap unknown
exposure_summary.selection_limit: BMRA channel selection used future-window availability/QC only, not forecast performance; claims must disclose this availability screen

jena.label_use: train/V/cal/E target labels used in Study31 development diagnostics
Jena 2024 validation/evaluation target labels exposed in S1

bmra.label_use: raw source was processed into 2019 train, 2020 val, 2021 test UCP panels
